item.title: Rallying Cry – August 22, 2026
item.description: From Lucy Davis sharing gratitude after her cancer diagnosis to Khartoum reviving movie nights under the stars, plus solar energy keeping Europe’s grid strong through extreme heat, today’s good news is full of resilience and renewal.
